questions_and_answers.question_text: What kind of verb is jìde?
Which word is rènde usually interchangeable with?
What kind of verb is wàng?
What is the literal meaning of zuǒyòu?
What three parts make up xiǎngqilai?

answers.answer_text: Xiǎng ("to think"), qǐ ("to rise"), and lái ("to come").

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "I forget people's names very easily."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ hěn róngyi bǎ rén míngzi wàng le.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Write the Chinese for "I will come to get you about five o'clock."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ wǔdiǎn zuǒyòu lái jiē ni.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Where does zuǒyòu stand in relation to the amount?
Write the Chinese for "I don't know anything about this matter."

answers.answer_text: Wǒ wánquán bù zhīdào zhèijiàn shì.

articles.text:
Notes on Additional Required Vocabulary

8.  jìde          to remember
9.  rènde         to recognize, to know (alternate word for rènshi)
10. rènshi zì     to know how to read
11. wàng          to forget (especially forgetting to DO something)
12. wánquán       completely
13. xiǎngqilai    to think of, to remember
14. zuǒyòu        approximately

The verb jìde, "to remember," acts like a state verb.

Nǐ jìde Wáng Xiǎo Míng ma?       Do you remember Wáng Xiǎo Míng?
Jìde.                            I remember him.
Wǒ zuótian bù jìde tā xìng       Yesterday I couldn't remember what
shénme. Jīntian yòu              his name is. Today I remembered
xiǎngqilai le.                   it again.

Rènde, "to recognize," "to know," is usually interchangeable with rènshi. Both rènshi and rènde are most often made negative with bù.

Nǐ rènde ta ma?                  Do you know him?
Bú rènde.                        No.
Tā lù yě bú rènde.               He doesn't even know the way.

Wàng, "to forget," is an ACTION verb.

Wǒ hěn róngyi bǎ rén míngzi      I forget people's names very easily.
wàng le.
Wǒ wàng le.                      I forgot (mine).
Wǒ méi wàng.                     I didn't forget.

Wánquán, "completely," is an adverb used to modify verbs.

Tā xiěde zì wánquán duì.         The character he wrote is completely
                                 right.
Wǒ wánquán bù zhīdào zhèijiàn    I don't know anything about this
shì.                             matter.

Xiǎngqilai, "to think of," "to remember," is a compound verb of result. It is made up of xiǎng, "to think"; qǐ, "to rise"; and lái, "to come." As an ending showing result, -qilai may have either its literal meaning of "to come up" or more abstract meanings such as "to come to mind." (Xiǎngqilai is actually pronounced xiángqilai.)

Qǐng bǎ yǐzi bānqilai.           Please lift up the chair.
Nèige zì wǒ xiǎngqilai le.       I remember that character.

Zuǒyòu (literally, "left-right") means "approximately," "about."

Wǒ wǔdiǎn zuǒyòu lái jiē ni.     I will come to get you about five
                                 o'clock.
Sānjīn zuǒyòu jiù gòu le.        About three catties should be enough.
